theorem: For any backward-closed record sets A,B, let R(C) be paid RES indices, O(C) globally declared paid gate-owner IDs that have a DEF facet in C. Then W(A union B)=W(A)+W(B)-|R(A) intersect R(B)|-|O(A) intersect O(B)|. In general O(A intersect B) is strictly smaller than O(A) intersect O(B), so record-overlap-only accounting overcharges. For a sink cone S, W_packet=W(S)+|R_all minus R(S)|+|G_all minus O(S)|.
distinction: This is exact accounting on accepted concrete /386 packets, not a superpolynomial lower bound or authenticated R_mix341 all-rule abstraction.
